about.title: The Word was never meant to be kept on a page.
about.body:
Wear The Word — Our Story

Every season of life comes with its own questions, challenges, battles, decisions and victories. And in every season, there is a Word from God to stand on.

A Word that gives courage when fear shows up. A Word that reminds us who we are when life tries to define us. A Word that gives hope when the future seems uncertain.

But we believe God’s Word should be more than something we read, quote or hear on Sundays. It should become part of who we are. It should shape how we think, how we live, how we speak and how we show up in the world.

## This is why Wear The Word was born.

Inspired by   Psalm 138:2  , we believe God’s Word deserves to be honoured, remembered, lived and boldly represented.

We create clothing and lifestyle pieces that turn timeless biblical truths into meaningful everyday expressions. Every design carries a message. Every message has a meaning. Every piece is an opportunity to remind someone of what God has said.

Because faith is not just what we say. It is what we believe, how we live and what we stand for.

## Don’t just read the Word. Don’t just speak the Word. Wear the Word.

Wear The Word by Pemart Global. Christian lifestyle, apparel & gifting. From Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.intro: The quick answers. If yours is not here, message us on WhatsApp.
faq.body:
## How long does delivery take?

Available estimates depend on the destination and service and are shown before payment. Custom production starts after proof approval.

## How do custom designs work?

Choose a tier on the Design Your Own page, pay at checkout, and we send you a proof: within 12 hours for Personalise, 24 hours for Text design and 48 hours for Full custom. Approve it, or ask for one free revision. Once you approve, production begins and delivery follows your confirmed service.

## How much do custom designs cost?

Personalise (change the name, date or verse on an existing design) adds ₦3,000. Text design (your own words in a Pemart type style) adds ₦5,000. Full custom (your idea or sketch) adds ₦15,000. These are on top of the price of the garment.

## Can I return a custom item?

Custom and personalised items are final sale, except for print defects or wrong items, which we replace free.

## Can I exchange the size?

Yes. Ready designs can be exchanged for another size within 7 days of delivery if unworn and unwashed.

## How do I pay?

Securely with Paystack by card, bank transfer or USSD, in Naira. Pay on delivery is not available at the moment.

## Is delivery free?

Eligible orders qualify for nationwide free delivery at the current threshold shown on our Delivery page and in your bag, after discounts. Below that threshold, confirmed service fees apply.

## What are Gift Boxes?

Ready-to-gift sets such as the Joy Box, the Couple’s Christmas Box and the Family Box. You choose designs, colours and sizes, add a gift message, and we pack it. They are available until 24 December.

## Do you do bulk orders for churches and events?

Yes. 10 to 24 pieces get 10% off, 25 to 99 pieces get 15% off, and 100 or more is by quote. Send us a request on the Bulk Orders page.

## How do I track my order?

Use the Track Order page with your order number and the phone or email you ordered with. You do not need an account.

## What is the print quality like?

Our tees are heavyweight oversized cotton, and designs are printed to order for a soft, durable finish. Wash inside out in cold water to keep them looking sharp.

## Can I ask a question before I buy?

Always. Tap the green WhatsApp button on any page and we will reply with the page you are on already attached.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us. Ask about sizes, custom designs, bulk orders or an order in progress.
contact.body:
## Have your order number ready

If you are asking about an order, include your order number (it looks like PM-10001). It helps us find it straight away.

delivery.title: Nationwide delivery
delivery.body:
## Delivery across Nigeria

We serve all 36 Nigerian states and the Federal Capital Territory. Enter your state, city and complete delivery address at checkout to see available services.

## Delivery fees and free delivery

The current free-delivery threshold is shown in your bag and at checkout. Eligibility is calculated after merchandise discounts. Only confirmed delivery services can be charged.

## When a service is pending

If a delivery service has not been confirmed for your destination, our team must confirm the fee and timing before order confirmation. We do not display unverified estimates as a promise.

## Custom orders

Production starts after you approve your design proof. Production and delivery timing depend on your order and confirmed service.

[Contact our team](/contact)

returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.intro: We want you to love what you ordered. Here is exactly how exchanges and replacements work.
returns.body:
## Ready designs: size exchanges

If your ready-design tee or hoodie does not fit, you can exchange it for another size within 7 days of delivery, as long as it is unworn and unwashed with the tags and packaging intact. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number and the size you need.

## Custom and personalised items

Anything made to your request (Personalise, Text design or Full custom) is final sale, because it is printed for you alone. You approve a proof before we print, and every custom order includes one free revision.

## Print defects and wrong items

If something arrives with a print defect, or it is not what you ordered, we will replace it free of charge, custom items included. Send a clear photo within 7 days of delivery and we will sort it out quickly.

## Accessories and gifts

Perfume, jewellery, bracelets, glasses and fun items can be returned only if they arrive faulty or damaged. Please keep the packaging and message us within 7 days.

## Gift cards

Digital gift cards are non-refundable and are delivered to the email address you provide.

## Refunds

Where a refund is due, it goes back to your original payment method through Paystack. Bank processing times vary, but it normally reaches you within a few working days.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: Plain-language terms for buying from Pemart.
terms.body:
## Orders and prices

All prices are in Nigerian Naira (₦). The price you pay is calculated by our system at checkout, including delivery, add-ons and any discount codes, and confirmed before you pay. An order is accepted once your payment is verified.

## Payment

We accept card, bank transfer and USSD through Paystack. Pay on delivery is not offered at this time. Unpaid orders are cancelled after 24 hours.

## Delivery

Delivery fees and any verified estimates are shown before payment. Custom orders require proof approval before production. Contact our team for timing specific to your order; courier delays may affect estimates.

## Custom and personalised orders

- You approve a design proof before printing. Every custom order includes one free revision; further revisions can be bought as an add-on.

- Custom and personalised items are final sale, except for print defects or wrong items, which we replace free.

- Content you upload: you confirm you own it or have permission to use it, and that it does not infringe anyone's rights or contain unlawful material. We may decline any design.

## Exchanges and returns

See Returns and Exchanges. In short: size exchanges on unworn, unwashed ready designs within 7 days, and free replacement for print defects.

## Discount codes, store credit and gift cards

Codes have their own conditions (such as a minimum spend, dates or one use per customer) and cannot be exchanged for cash. Store credit and gift cards are redeemed at checkout, and gift cards may have an expiry date shown on the card.

## Reviews

Reviews are moderated. Photo reviews approved by us earn store credit as described when we invite you to review.

## Liability

To the extent the law allows, our liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it.

## Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: We collect only what we need to make, deliver and support your order. This page explains what that is.
privacy.body:
## What we collect

- Contact details: name, email and phone (used for order updates, including on WhatsApp).

- Delivery details: your address and delivery area.

- Orders: what you bought, the options you chose, gift messages and payment status.

- Custom design files: text, images, PDFs or sketches you upload, and the proofs we send back.

- Account: if you sign in, your email or Google account name and email, saved addresses, wishlist and store credit.

- Reviews: ratings, comments and photos you choose to submit.

- Newsletter and offers: your email or phone, the date and time you opted in, and the single-use first-order code we issued to you.

- Bulk quote requests: your name, organisation, contact details and what you want made.

We never see or store your card details. Payments are handled by Paystack.

## How we use it

To process and deliver orders, send proofs and updates, give support, prevent fraud, and, only if you opted in, send offers. You can opt out of marketing at any time.

## Who we share it with

- Paystack to take payments.

- Supabase for our database, sign-in and file storage.

- Resend to send emails.

- Vercel to host this website.

- Delivery partners, who receive your name, phone and address to deliver your parcel.

We do not sell your personal data.

## Cookies and analytics

Essential storage keeps your bag and sign-in working. Where optional analytics or marketing cookies are offered, they require your consent. You can change those choices using Cookie settings in the footer when that feature is enabled.

## Your uploads

Design files you upload are stored privately and used only to produce your order. Please only upload images you have the right to use.

## Keeping and deleting data

We keep order records for as long as needed for accounting and support. You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal data, subject to records we must keep by law, by messaging us on WhatsApp. We handle personal data in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act.

## Changes

If this policy changes in a meaningful way, we will update this page.
